user.title: Add Growatt inverter
user.description: Enter the connection details for one inverter. To keep your existing helpers/automations working, use the exact same device name you used in the previous integration (e.g. "Growatt-SPH-10K" or "Growatt-MIC1500").

data_description.protocol_v201: Also poll the 30000+/31000+ VPP register range. Adds battery state of health, signed battery power, the VPP export limit control and the control-authority gate. Enable only if your inverter answers on that range - if it does not, the extra reads simply fail and the entities stay unavailable.
data_description.block_size: Lower this if your RS485-to-TCP gateway rejects long reads (symptom: every sensor unavailable while the inverter itself is reachable). "auto" uses the block layout from the register map.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Growatt inverter
reconfigure.description: Edit this inverter's connection/polling settings in place.

abort.already_configured: This inverter (host/port/slave ID) is already configured.
